column1: # Silver Pines: registered 1.0.0 (v0), SDK 21.4.7, NVN. The registered build has not been run on Android.
# Community runs by dusk-beep of update 1.0.2 (v131072) through a porter-derived profile, with the bounded
# shader export of #562: POCO X3 Pro (Snapdragon 860 / Adreno 640, 6 GB, Android 13), Turnip Mesa 27.0.0-devel.
# Run of 2026-11-24: 28 minutes, 43,073 frames, 66,250 shaders in the bundle, no [RED] line, 21 save commits.
# The tester saw no rendering errors on the street or in the diner, and frequent drops to about 15 fps.
# The source commit was not reported. Registering 1.0.2 waits for its derived shader tables; see README.md.
